long_description:
🌟 Bay Area, get ready for an unforgettable night of Garba and Dandiya! 💃

Sulekha.com/PanchamGarba

Dance to traditional Gujarati favorites and Bollywood hits, powered by vibrant, thunderous dandiya beats from Bay Area’s premium live band, Pancham Beats!

✨ The evening features:

* Live singing by talented Bay Area singers and musicians - Dhawal Majmudar, Dipa Singh, Vaishvi Ebrado, Rachana Nail, Tanmay Shah, Jello Johncarlo

* Exciting prizes to win

* A special Mumbai Gaadi segment for kids

* A fashion show with Bay Area’s fashion, dance, and music queen, Reema Khanolkar

* A grand finale with DJ Senthil

* Delicious food available for purchase

📅 Thursday, October 15, 2026

🕢 7:30 PM

📍 Shubham Halls

1214 Apollo Way, Sunnyvale, CA 94085

Conveniently scheduled on a Thursday so you can celebrate without competing with other events!

Organizers: Pancham Beats and Meri Saheli Kitty Group

For sponsorship and other inquiries:

562-724-2426 | 650-669-0281
